review_description: The entire process was seamless and highly efficient.  No 'sales talk', only clear and concise information with an emphasis on finding the best and most cost effective solution.  No attempt to 'upsell', and where they could find a more suitable approach they do so with an emphasis  on the customer. I found the CEO Daniel to be ethical, helpful, customer focused and genuine. They claim to have never received a negative review, ever, and I can see why.The installation occurred only days after my initial enquiry and feedback/advice was forthcoming throughout the fitment.  They turned up on time, got the job done and all the STC paperwork was completed online.  I can't speak highly enough of this company and highly recommend them.

Daniel and the team have always been excellent to deal with. I was expecting great savings with my solar kit (which I got in spades!) but the sales and afterservice was far better than I anticipated. Organising the switch over with my energy provider and everything. Total thanks Daniel and team.

The quote was straight to the point, no marketing spills, no pretence brutally honest. The quality of the products I got is tops at a very reasonable price. When I accepted the quote, Daniel did not even ask for a deposit and the team installed my system in 2 weeks. My solar was up and running after 2 weeks. My system paid back after 2.5 years as per Daniel's quote. I still receive average of $100/mo refund from my solar. I will highly recommend the team.

The installation process was made easy with no hassle and reduced our bills drastically. We even received credits from the supplier carrying forward meaning we haven't paid for electricity charges for a while.

Thank You everyone, Daniel, James & the rest of the guys for a job well done. Arrived ahead of time which was good as some rain arrived later. The installation went without any drama, the inverter was installed where I wanted it.All together it was a very pleasant experience.I would recommend this company & the installers to everyone that wants a value for money product efficiently installed by a bunch of very nice guys.
